name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
summary: In Northshire's northern woods, kobold numbers threaten the abbey grounds. Marshal McBride needs the camps cleared, and the valley's defense depends on fresh volunteers.

sections.title: A Valley Under Pressure
sections.body: Marshal McBride directs the valley's defense from Northshire Abbey, but he has too few soldiers. So he depends on fresh volunteers like you. Each threat he cannot answer could disrupt the abbey's work or spread into the vineyards nearby. The kobold camps cannot wait.

sections.title: The Vermin in the Woods
sections.body: Kobolds are timid, candle-obsessed cave-dwellers who usually pick at underground seams, away from direct sunlight. Now an entire clan has reached the northern timberline. Left alone, their numbers could turn scavenging into open raids. McBride sends you to thin their vanguard and test your resolve to defend the realm.

faq.q: Who orders the culling of the kobold camp?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride orders the culling. From Northshire Abbey, he oversees recruit intake and the valley's security for Stormwind.

faq.q: Why are kobolds in the northern woods instead of a mine?
faq.answer: Northshire's growing population has spilled into the open forest, where kobolds have made primitive camps among the northern trees near the edge of civilized land. They usually live in burrows and mines.

faq.q: Why are these kobolds considered a threat to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Kobold vermin are timid and weak alone. In packs, they can ambush travelers, raid supplies, and overwhelm unguarded outposts. Stormwind can ill afford this threat while its forces are stretched thin.

faq.q: Where does this mission lead next?
faq.answer: After thinning the kobolds on the surface, recruits are sent deeper into Echo Ridge Mine to investigate, where the heart of the infestation lies.

faq.q: Is Northshire receiving regular royal army backup?
faq.answer: No. Political tension and troop shortages after King Varian's disappearance leave commanders like McBride relying on civilian volunteers, adventurers, and trainees for border security.

faq.q: What makes kobolds so attached to their candles?
faq.answer: Kobolds revere candles as their main defense against the smothering darkness of underground tunnels. Their flames give them safety, sight, and a sense of ownership.

angles.text: As a human of Northshire, driving back kobold vermin helps protect the abbey and farmland from being overrun. It is a civic duty.
As an Alliance member, you can see the strain on Stormwind's home territories. Even scavenger infestations call for urgent help from volunteer militia.
